S4: Independent propagation necessary-condition certificate before every policy; no artificial candidate, no M2 or LLM.
local_evidence: After both phases, run unchanged Stage4 full six-sweep/refinements plus Stage4.1 steps for analytical S0 and S3 only, budget maximum800 native calls total. All others explicitly NOT_MEASURED_THIS_ROUND.
acceptance: M1/M2 separate; measured subset explicitly {BW_Hz}; strict PM/frequency UNKNOWN; any certified hard FAIL dominates UNKNOWN; no full verified PASS.
